{{Event Infobox
| Name  = World of Goop
| Image = Event-Goop.png
}}
{{E|World of Goop}} is an [[Event]] encountered exclusively in [[Act 1]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Gather Gold}} {{TS|positive||Gain 75 Gold.}} {{TS|negative||Lose 11 HP.}}
<br><br>
{{Frame|Leave It}} {{TS|negative||Lose X Gold.}}
* X is a random number between 20 and 50 {{Asc|15|(35 and 75)}} Gold. X cannot be more Gold than the player currently has.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You fall into a puddle.
<br>
{{TS||shake|IT'S MADE OF}} {{TS|green|shake|SLIME GOOP!!}}
<br>
Frantically, you claw yourself out over several minutes as you feel the goop starting to burn.
<br>
You can feel goop in your ears, goop in your nose, goop everywhere.
<br><br>
Climbing out, you notice that some of your {{TS|gold||gold}} is missing. Looking back to the puddle you see your missing coins combined with {{TS|gold||gold}} from unfortunate adventurers mixed together in the puddle.
</div>

{{Frame|Gather Gold}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Feeling the sting of the goop as the prolonged exposure starts to melt away at your skin, you manage to fish out the {{TS|gold||gold.}}
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave It}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You decide that mess is not worth it.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* The name "World of Goop" is a reference to the puzzle game [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_of_Goo World of Goo].

== Update History ==
* '''Day 1 Patch'''
** Goop Puddle event slightly reworked to be more interesting.
